propositions: Reconciler lacks a runtime mechanism to select which Backend implementation to use; vendor is currently implicit in module imports.
Backend selection infrastructure must add a reconciler.backend config field (defaulting to 'jira'), validated by _as_choice coercer at config-load time to reject unknown keys.
A decorator-registry pattern with select_backend(config) function must resolve the configured backend key to a Backend factory and construct the appropriate Backend instance.
JiraBackend must be registered in the in-tree registry via @register decorator, with lazy import of adapters package inside select_backend to populate the registry deterministically.

Existing consumers (load_acli, AcliClient construction, differ/apply modules) are explicitly NOT rewired in this story; selection infrastructure is proven independently before S4 rewires all call sites.
